title: WorkplaceSafetyEvent
description: Standardized event schema for PipeGen/DeepStream workplace safety analytics and zone intrusion detection.

schema_version.description: Schema version indicator for forward/backward compatibility.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific event instance.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred (e.g. 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z).

camera_id.description: Unique identifier for camera stream or video file source.

track_id.description: Unique tracking ID from tracker (e.g. NvSORT/NvDCF/DeepSORT). Null if tracking is not enabled.

confidence.description: Detection confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0. Null if unavailable.

zone_id.description: Identifier of the restricted safety zone.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the safety event.

bbox.description: Optional bounding box coordinates [left, top, right, bottom].

dwell_time_seconds.description: Dwell time inside restricted zone in seconds.

details.description: Optional extra metadata (e.g. frame number, membership rule, speed).
